source_manifest.rehash_reason: main appended only the compact_preparation pointer block; no raster asset, checksum or inventory entry used by T8 changed

grid.vertical_reference: LN02 / EPSG:5728; inspect per-asset header metadata
grid.format: NumPy NPY v1/v2 as emitted by numpy.save/open_memmap

occluder_buffer.selection: Tiles intersecting the canton or a conservative L-infinity expansion; includes every tile intersecting the Euclidean buffer
occluder_buffer.height_and_low_sun_policy: 250m is a planning envelope, not a verified city maximum. T8/T10 must account for terrain relief along rays as well as object height; extend coverage or mark unknown when actual ray reach exceeds available geometry. Below 10 degrees, mark unsupported/unknown; night is a separate state.
occluder_buffer.missing_buffer_policy: Receiver cells whose sunward ray reaches absent or NoData geometry remain unknown

pair_valid.meaning: both source cells are finite and not NoData

surface_below_terrain.action_for_T10: preserve both source values but treat the cell, and an otherwise unresolved ray crossing it, as unknown; never silently clamp

surface_below_terrain_by_more_than_1m.action_for_T10: same unknown policy; separate count is a QA severity flag

nominal_year_mismatch.action_for_T10: retain the tile with both nominal years in the geometry version; the mismatch alone does not invalidate unflagged cells

memory.t0_audit_method: Windows GetProcessMemoryInfo peak working set in one Python process, including four full pair decodes and two threaded 500x500 kernels. Local warmed file cache; not API latency or separate worker memory. Python and NumPy versions recorded with samples.
memory.t8_measurement_method: Windows Get-Process PeakWorkingSet64 for the Python child during the full two-worker preparation run
